text: When my husband and I met Chris and Hannah (The Ranch Real Estate Group) we had no idea what our plans were but knew we weren’t prepared! Chris was very patient with us! In the middle of deciding what we wanted to do about selling we unexpectedly found the perfect new home and just like that, Hannah swooped in to help us navigate the purchase! She helped to negotiate a perfect deal, getting us under asking in a market in which that is unheard of!! This kicked everything with selling into high gear but Chris had no problem getting our house on the market with just a few days notice. Through both transactions their team, Makenzee and Josh, were there to give us regular updates and everyone kept in constant communication. I would never recommend anyone but the Ranch Group!
